groups.name: engine
groups.residual: Native/callback error combinations and implicit/library branches retain their scoped dispositions.

groups.name: schema
groups.residual: Fallible primitive calls remain delegated; source pairs are not compiler-expanded coverage.

groups.name: memory
groups.residual: Allocator implementation and unsupported platform/resource combinations remain separate.

groups.name: value
groups.residual: Delegated allocations and internal trait/compiler behavior are not inferred as independent pairs.

groups.name: tree
groups.residual: Invariant and delegated dispositions retain the exact valid-structure domain.

groups.name: ffi
groups.residual: Generated export templates, pointer/lifetime contracts and per-ABI outcomes retain supplemental scope.

groups.name: storage
groups.residual: Native persistence assumptions and delegated calls remain separate from simulated pairs.

groups.name: codec
groups.residual: Checked/implicit arithmetic, delegated primitives and compiler-expanded records remain separate. Cursor conversion is scoped to qualified 64-bit ABIs; narrower targets remain delegated.

groups.name: native
groups.residual: Kernel outcomes, coupled pathname predicates, unsupported ABIs and physical power loss remain separate from callback controls.

groups.name: simulator
groups.residual: Finite modeled schedules and allocation errors do not establish native device behavior.

groups.name: replacement
groups.residual: Namespace model evidence and real filesystem/device durability remain distinct.

groups.name: operations
groups.residual: Complete-root salvage and known format/version profiles do not imply arbitrary partial salvage/conversion.

groups.name: diagnostics
groups.residual: Platform/native diagnostic production and arbitrary application sinks retain separate scope.

groups.name: core-support
groups.residual: Build identity, derived traits and conditional exports require their exact delivered configurations.

groups.name: typed
groups.residual: Generic instantiations and primitive errors retain scoped E/D evidence; named admission pairs do not close all residuals.

groups.name: macros
groups.residual: Quote bodies and every possible generated compilation/instantiation are outside the pre-expansion denominator.

groups.name: crdt
groups.residual: Lawful compatible histories and concrete Record instantiations do not prove arbitrary app algebra or all callback failures.

groups.name: replication
groups.residual: Exact local/follower acknowledgment contracts remain separate; broader transport/OS errors remain delegated.

groups.name: tasks
groups.residual: Underlying typed/core errors and command platform variants retain their named scope.

groups.name: study
groups.residual: Fixed-roster deployment, raw reserved rows and native stream errors remain explicit application obligations.

groups.name: snapshot-cli
groups.residual: Native/socket/dependency errors and operator/device profiles retain their separate scoped evidence.

groups.name: coordinator
groups.residual: Slot/receipt retirement, stale restore, I/O and deployment policies retain explicit acceptance gates.

groups.name: shared-app-support
groups.residual: TLS dependency/native outcomes and generated logging/error branches are not inferred covered for every binary.

groups.name: drivers
groups.residual: Admin callback progress pairs are named separately; measurement/fault drivers keep delegated and private-invocation limits.

groups.name: qualification-tooling
groups.residual: Helper and native negative controls remain scoped evidence, not individual independence pairs for all tooling records. Standalone workspaces and consumers are now inventoried in their own target contexts; their records and macro/compiled boundaries remain explicit obligations.

groups.name: standalone-and-example-tooling
groups.residual: Additional Cargo target contexts and oracle/consumer code retain individual G obligations. Macro expansion, compiled configurations and delegated/native behavior need separate qualification.
